timeline.title: MHA Launches Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C)
timeline.impact: Operationalized NCRP national portal and CFCFRMS financial fraud helpline.

timeline.title: Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Ransomware Attack
timeline.impact: NetWalker gang hit major pharma firm; forced global data center shutdown.

timeline.title: RedEcho Threat Group Probes Indian Power Sector
timeline.impact: Recorded Future report revealed APT41 targeting 10 regional load dispatch centres.

timeline.title: CERT-In Issues Mandatory 6-Hour Cyber Incident Reporting
timeline.impact: Mandated all corporate & govt entities report breaches within 6 hours of detection.

timeline.title: AIIMS Delhi Medical Systems Ransomware Lockdown
timeline.impact: Crippled AIIMS for 14 days; landmark event highlighting healthcare vulnerabilities.

timeline.title: CDSL LockBit 3.0 Malware Attack
timeline.impact: Halted trade settlements for 46 hours; SEBI issued strict compliance order.

timeline.title: Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act 2023 Passed
timeline.impact: Established Data Protection Board of India; penalties up to ₹250 Cr for data leaks.

timeline.title: ICMR 81.5 Crore Citizen COVID-19 Data Breach
timeline.impact: Massive leak of Aadhaar/Passport PII advertised on dark web; Delhi Police arrested 4.

timeline.title: UCO Bank IMPS Technical Glitch Fraud (₹820 Cr)
timeline.impact: Systemic glitch exploited to credit ₹820 Cr erroneous funds; CBI recovered ₹640 Cr.

timeline.title: Union Home Minister Launches 'Cyber Commando' Wing
timeline.impact: Specialized force of trained cyber security personnel across State/UT police forces.

timeline.title: PM Modi Warns Nation Against 'Digital Arrest' Scams
timeline.impact: National broadcast alerting citizens that no legal provision for digital arrest exists.

timeline.title: World Leaks Group Releases NPCIL Contractor Data
timeline.impact: NPCIL confirmed non-nuclear drawings leaked; nuclear safety systems uncompromised.

timeline.title: SEBI Imposes ₹1 Crore Fine on CDSL Over 2022 Breach
timeline.impact: Landmark SEBI order penalizing depository for systemic cyber security lapses during LockBit attack.

timeline.title: CERT-In Issues High Alert on AI Deepfake Voice Cloning Scams
timeline.impact: Advisory targeting corporate C-suite executives following ₹24.5 Cr audio impersonation heist in Bengaluru.
